text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Aoi Stakes. Yamanin Zephyr senses a familiar buzzing in her ears and comes to a realization…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The world that was once home to her wind alone now has other winds blowing through it—her world has grown wider.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio is going to run in the Japanese Derby tomorrow. Certain that her friend will win, Zephyr endeavors to run even better.
